style: Quiet instrumental music in an empty glass signal hall at night. A soft felt piano and muted celesta play sparse, sad minor phrases above a cold analog synthesizer pad and sustained low cello. Long tape echoes and distant metal chimes, restrained and desolate, lots of silence between notes. No drums. Purely instrumental. Em, 100 BPM.
